commitResults.messageBody:
The chatbot classes are in the default package, which does not follow the SE-EDU Java coding standard.

Move the classes into a gpt package and update names, constants, Javadocs, and README setup guidance so the code is easier to read and run.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add SE-EDU Java coding standard skill
commitResults.messageBody:
The project needs reusable guidance for applying the SE-EDU Java coding standard in future Java changes.

Add a project-specific skill that captures the key package, naming, layout, import, comment, and Javadoc rules from the SE-EDU intermediate Java guide.

The project needs reusable guidance for proposing and creating commit messages that follow the SE-EDU Git conventions.

Add a project-specific skill covering subject format, commit body expectations, commit scope, and branch naming guidance from the SE-EDU Git guide.

commitResults.messageTitle: Require SE-EDU standards in agent guidance
commitResults.messageBody:
Future code and commit work in this project should consistently use the reusable project-specific SE-EDU standards.

Update AGENTS.md to require the Java coding standard skill for Java work and the Git standard skill for commit-related work.
